svg.title: One cycle of a periodic function, repeated
svg.desc: The depth of water in a tank, in feet, over 18 minutes. In each 6-minute cycle the depth rises in a straight line from 1 foot to 5 feet in 2 minutes, stays at 5 feet for 1 minute, then falls in a straight line back to 1 foot over 3 minutes. The first cycle, from t = 0 to t = 6, is shaded and drawn in green; the next two cycles are exact copies. A bracket marks the period, 6 minutes.
